quotations.old_english: On ðæm cnihtgebeorþre heó á clǽne þurhwunode
quotations.english: in child-bearing she continued ever immaculate

source_text: cniht-gebeorþor; gen. -gebeorþres; n. A boy-bearing, child-bearing; pueri partus :-- On ðæm cnihtgebeorþre heó á clǽne þurhwunode in child-bearing she continued ever immaculate, Homl. Blick. 3, 12.
